quotes.text: Outlook.com has quietly dropped emails from certain domains/IPs for years, even with SPF/DKIM/DMARC all properly set up and no history of spam. They accept the email just fine according to the logs — but it still doesn't end up in the recipient's mailbox.
quotes.author: codethief
quotes.source: Hacker News — Outlook.com is rejecting email from domains without DMARC
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect self-horror for anyone who's run their own mail server — the silent-drop detail is the painful punchline.
